title: patience
style: Afro-pop with electronic dance elements. A syncopated kick drum pattern drives the rhythm at 110 BPM in the key of G minor. The track features a layered vocal arrangement including a female lead, male lead, and harmonized backing choir. A prominent percussive synth bass provides a rhythmic counterpoint to the kick. Instrumentation includes shakers, woodblocks, and a bright, plucked synth lead that plays a repetitive melodic hook. The production uses heavy reverb on the vocal ad-libs and a clean, dry mix for the verses. A filtered synth pad provides harmonic texture during the transitions.
lyrics:
[Intro]
[female vocalizing with heavy reverb]
[shakers and woodblock enter]
Hi-ya-na-ba, hi-ya-na-ba, hi-ya-na-ba-ya-da-di-di
[kick drum and synth bass enter]

[Verse 1]
[female lead vocals]
Eye on the ball, feeling good
Hitting it like the way you should
Next ball is mine, hit it right down the line
Patience is the key
Patience will set you free
[choir backing vocals]
Patience
Patience
Patience
[female lead vocals]
Patience will set you free

[Verse 2]
[male lead vocals]
Control the ball, fancy free
That's how we play, you and me
Wait for the moment then take your chance
First, patience is not a race
Ten shots in the kitchen
Sweat dripping hot from the planning
Waiting for the moment

[Chorus]
[female lead and choir]
Ooh-ooh-ooh
Patience will set you free
Take a ride with me
[instrumental outro with synth hook and driving percussion]
